summary: Quiet residential kerb with homes 13 m away all round.
reasons: Quiet street, a car parks nearby

best_section.where: Ellerslie Crescent south kerb, at the bend near the carport

drivers.seclusion: Detached homes 13-17 m away on both sides; no buffer of bush or park.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed residential road, kerb with space for a van; cars parked nearby.
drivers.traffic: Quiet dead-end style crescent, little through traffic.
drivers.convention: Residential kerb with no parking convention for overnight vans.

sun_shade: Mostly open; tree shade from the north-east at the middle of the stretch.
